title: Description doesn't warn you
text: Description doesn't warn you. Just had a plumber here.  He saw this sitting nearby and warned me, if I use this, it's going to blow out the wax seals. And you won't know it right away.  It will leak, the subfloor will rot and you won't know how bad the floor is likely until it's too late. You're better off getting a toilet snake.  It costs the same but won't cause irreparable damage to the seals.

product_metadata.title: 9 in 1 Air Plunger for Toilet, Toilet Plunger, Drain Plumb Plunger, Power Plunger, High Pressure with 9 Detachable Assembly Heads for Plugging Toilets, Kitchens, Bathrooms,Drains,Bathtubs (gray)
features: 5 Free Replaceable Heads.flexible Handles and One Drive Button for Easy Operating, Never Have to Call a Plumber Or Use of Harsh Chemicals. Abs Plastic Handle, the Surface is Smooth and Easy to Clean.

9-in-1 Pneumatic Plunger Kit: 9 accessories are given for free, which can be used perfectly in one full breath, avoiding repeated inflation. At the same time, the Air Plunger is equipped with a professional instrument panel to accurately control pneumatic activities and operating forces. (It is recommended to inflate to the barometer pointer position 2-4) Real-time display of pressure, adjustable exhaust blasting gun according to different dredging requirements, to avoid splashing and damage.

The blaster pump is connected with the gun main plunger body and the air pressure is greater than that of the ordinary non-inflator, which is more convenient to use. The drain blaster uses the power of high-pressure compressed air to blast away the clogs quickly and easily,Plunger head ensures an sealing for great pressure.The air pressure is large and can be reused without having to inflate multiple times in an anxious situation.Much faster and more effective than traditional plunger and snake.

The plunger has a white ring hung on the wall, which can be hung on the ring after use to prevent the plunger from lying on a wet surface after use. A variety of occasions: suitable for all occasions, toilets, squats, kitchens, swimming pools, wash basins. Suitable for all kinds of pipelines. It can deal with various blockages caused by various garbage such as hair, cloth, tea leaves, leaves, grease, and oil. Environmental protection.
